routes.name: Federal Skilled Worker Program (FSWP) — Express Entry
routes.who_for: Skilled professionals with foreign work experience who want PR without a Canadian job offer.
routes.requirements: 67-point selection grid (language, education, experience, age, arranged employment, adaptability) to enter the Express Entry pool; then ranked by CRS. Minimum language CLB 7 in all abilities. Skilled work experience in a TEER 0–3 occupation. Educational credential assessment (ECA) for foreign degrees. Proof of funds required unless exempt.

checker.points_system: Two-stage: 67-point FSWP eligibility grid, then CRS ranking in Express Entry pool. No fixed CRS pass mark — draws vary (single official example verified: Healthcare category round 4 Sep 2026, lowest invited CRS 475).
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Proof of funds: CAD 15,263 for 1 person (updated 7 Jul 2025); scales with family size
checker.min_education: Secondary minimum; foreign credentials need ECA
checker.occupation_list_required: TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3 occupation
checker.notes: From 3 Nov 2026 a Canadian job offer no longer requires an LMIA for Express Entry purposes, but a job offer is NOT required for this route.

routes.fees: CAD 1,590 including Right of Permanent Residence Fee (verified 2026-11-12)

family.spouse: Yes — spouse/partner and dependent children are included in the PR application
family.spouse_work: Spouse becomes a permanent resident with full work rights
family.children: Yes, as dependants in the application
family.parents: No — parents are never dependants on economic routes. Separate Parent and Grandparent Program is invitation-only (closed to new intake 9 Oct 2025 at research date); Super Visa allows visits up to 5 years per stay, visitor status only.

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence. PR retention: 730 days physically in Canada in each 5-year period. Citizenship: 1,095 days in 5 years.
routes.obstacles: No fixed CRS cut-off — competitiveness depends on the draw; general draws have run well above most applicants' scores. Category-based rounds favour specific sectors (e.g. healthcare, French speakers).
next_steps: Get an ECA for your highest qualification
Take an approved English/French test and target CLB 9+ for CRS competitiveness
Check your CRS with the official IRCC calculator
Create an Express Entry profile if you meet the 67-point grid
Prepare proof of funds at the current table value

routes.name: Canadian Experience Class (CEC) — Express Entry
routes.who_for: People who already have at least 1 year of skilled work experience inside Canada.
routes.requirements: At least 1 year of skilled work experience in Canada (TEER 0–3) in the 3 years before applying. Language CLB 7 for TEER 0/1 jobs, CLB 5 for TEER 2/3 jobs. No proof of funds required. No education minimum (points for education still help CRS).

checker.points_system: Express Entry CRS ranking after eligibility
checker.occupation_list_required: TEER 0, 1, 2 or 3; experience must be in Canada
checker.notes: Requires prior Canadian work experience — not open to applicants who have never worked in Canada.

routes.fees: UNVERIFIED in v1 research pass — check IRCC fee list before publishing

family.spouse: Yes, included in PR application with full work rights as PR
family.parents: No — separate PGP (invitation-only, closed to new intake 9 Oct 2025) or Super Visa (visitor only).

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence. PR retention 730 days/5 years; citizenship 1,095 days/5 years.
routes.obstacles: Only useful after a period of authorised Canadian work (e.g. PGWP or employer work permit) — not a first-entry route from India.
next_steps: Confirm your Canadian experience is in a TEER 0–3 occupation
Take the language test at the right CLB level for your TEER
Enter the Express Entry pool under CEC
Keep Canadian employment records and pay slips as evidence

routes.name: Federal Skilled Trades Program (FSTP) — Express Entry
routes.who_for: Skilled tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, chefs, etc.) with a Canadian job offer or Canadian trade certificate.
routes.requirements: Skilled trades experience in an eligible trade group. Language CLB 5 for speaking/listening, CLB 4 for reading/writing. Requires EITHER a valid job offer of at least 1 year from a Canadian employer OR a certificate of qualification in the trade issued by a Canadian provincial/territorial authority. Proof of funds applies unless exempt.

checker.points_system: Express Entry CRS ranking after eligibility
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Proof of funds applies (same Express Entry table; 1 person CAD 15,263, updated 7 Jul 2025)
checker.occupation_list_required: Eligible skilled trades groups only
checker.notes: needs_job_offer is true UNLESS the applicant holds a Canadian certificate of qualification in the trade instead.

routes.fees: UNVERIFIED in v1 research pass — check IRCC fee list before publishing

family.spouse: Yes, included in PR application
family.parents: No — separate PGP (invitation-only, closed to new intake 9 Oct 2025) or Super Visa (visitor only).

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence. PR retention 730 days/5 years; citizenship 1,095 days/5 years.
routes.obstacles: The Canadian certificate of qualification is hard to obtain from overseas; most overseas applicants realistically need the 1-year Canadian job offer first.
next_steps: Check your trade is in an eligible FSTP group
Decide between the job-offer route and a provincial certificate of qualification
Take the language test (CLB 5/4 thresholds)
Enter the Express Entry pool under FSTP

routes.name: Provincial Nominee Program (PNP)
routes.who_for: Professionals whose skills match a specific province's labour needs; many streams run through Express Entry.
routes.requirements: Each province/territory and stream has its own criteria (occupation, job offer, language, funds vary). An Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points, which in practice guarantees an invitation. Non-EE streams apply on paper/directly to IRCC. Because criteria are province- and stream-specific, generic figures are UNVERIFIED and intentionally not coded.

checker.points_system: Varies by province/stream; EE-aligned nomination = +600 CRS
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Varies by stream — UNVERIFIED generically
checker.min_education: Varies by stream
checker.occupation_list_required: Varies by province/stream
checker.notes: Checker must branch to the specific province/stream before testing any numeric criterion.

routes.fees: UNVERIFIED generically — provinces charge their own nomination fees on top of federal fees

family.spouse: Yes, included in PR application
family.parents: No — separate PGP (invitation-only, closed to new intake 9 Oct 2025) or Super Visa (visitor only).

routes.pr_path: Permanent residence via nomination + federal approval. Must genuinely intend to live in the nominating province.
routes.obstacles: Streams open and close quickly; many require a provincial job offer or prior provincial ties. Choosing a province is a real commitment, not a back door to another province.
next_steps: Pick provinces where your occupation is in demand
Check whether the stream is Express Entry-aligned
Review the stream guide for job-offer and language rules before applying
Apply to the province, then complete the federal stage after nomination

routes.name: Atlantic Immigration Program (AIP)
routes.who_for: Skilled workers and international graduates with a job offer from a designated employer in Atlantic Canada (NB, NS, PEI, NL).
routes.requirements: Full-time, non-seasonal job offer from a designated Atlantic employer in a TEER 0–4 occupation. Language CLB 5 for TEER 0–3, CLB 4 for TEER 4. Work experience or an Atlantic international-graduate exemption. Settlement plan and provincial endorsement required. Funds set by a formula (12.5% of the urban LICO for the community size) — the exact table value is UNVERIFIED and not coded.

checker.min_education: Canadian or ECA-assessed credential at the level the stream requires
checker.occupation_list_required: TEER 0–4 with a designated Atlantic employer
checker.notes: Employer must be designated by the Atlantic province before the offer counts.

routes.fees: UNVERIFIED in v1 research pass — check IRCC fee list before publishing

family.spouse: Yes, included in PR application
family.parents: No — separate PGP (invitation-only, closed to new intake 9 Oct 2025) or Super Visa (visitor only).

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence with provincial endorsement.
routes.obstacles: Depends entirely on finding a designated employer in a smaller regional labour market; fewer openings than national programs.
next_steps: Search the designated-employer lists for the four Atlantic provinces
Secure a qualifying full-time offer
Complete a settlement plan with a designated settlement service provider
Get provincial endorsement, then apply to IRCC for PR

routes.name: Skilled Independent visa (subclass 189)
routes.who_for: Skilled professionals in an occupation on the skilled occupation list, invited without any sponsor or employer.
routes.requirements: Points-tested. Must be under 45 at invitation. Competent English minimum (IELTS 6 in each component or equivalent). Points floor is 65, but realistic invited scores in the 15 Oct 2026 invitation round were 65–100 depending on occupation — 65 rarely suffices for popular occupations. Positive skills assessment in the nominated occupation required. Invitation via SkillSelect EOI.

checker.points_system: Points test: 65-point legal floor; realistic invitations 65–100 by occupation (15 Oct 2026 round)
checker.min_language: Competent English — IELTS 6.0 in each component or equivalent
checker.min_education: Qualification assessed as comparable by the occupation's assessing authority
checker.occupation_list_required: Must be on the skilled occupation list with a positive skills assessment
checker.notes: Age test applies at the date of invitation, not EOI.

routes.fees: From AUD 6,135 (main applicant)

family.spouse: Yes — partner and children can be included in the application
family.spouse_work: Partner becomes a permanent resident with full work rights
family.parents: No — parents can never be included; only via the separate Parent visa queue.

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence. Citizenship generally after 4 years' residence including the last 12 months as a permanent resident.
routes.obstacles: Invitation rounds are competitive and occupation-dependent; popular occupations (ICT, accounting, engineering) need high points (often 85+). Skills assessment processing adds months before the EOI can compete.
next_steps: Check your occupation is on the skilled list and identify its assessing authority
Complete the skills assessment
Take an English test — aim for Superior English (IELTS 8) for maximum points
Submit an EOI in SkillSelect
Lodge the visa application within 60 days of invitation

routes.name: Skilled Nominated visa (subclass 190)
routes.who_for: Skilled professionals nominated by an Australian state or territory government.
routes.requirements: Points-tested; under 45 at invitation; Competent English (IELTS 6 each). 65-point floor including the nomination points (the exact '+5 for nomination' figure is UNVERIFIED in the v1 pass and not coded). Each state runs its own occupation list and criteria, and some require a job offer or prior state residence/study.

checker.points_system: Points test: 65-point floor including state nomination points (nomination value UNVERIFIED — do not hard-code)
checker.min_language: Competent English — IELTS 6.0 in each component or equivalent
checker.min_education: Qualification assessed as comparable by the occupation's assessing authority
checker.occupation_list_required: Skilled occupation list AND the nominating state's own list/criteria
checker.notes: Some state programs require a job offer or state connection — check the specific state before answering 'no job offer needed'.

routes.fees: From AUD 6,140 (main applicant)

family.spouse: Yes, included in the application
family.spouse_work: Full work rights as permanent resident
family.parents: No — separate Parent visa only.

routes.pr_path: Direct permanent residence, with a moral (non-legal) expectation to live in the nominating state for the first period. Citizenship: 4 years incl. last 12 months as PR.
routes.obstacles: State programs open/close and change criteria through the year; nomination places are capped per state per year.
next_steps: Compare state lists for your occupation
Complete skills assessment and English test
Submit EOI selecting the state(s)
Apply for state nomination when invited by the state
Lodge the visa after nomination is approved

routes.name: Skilled Work Regional (Provisional) visa (subclass 491)
routes.who_for: Skilled professionals willing to live and work in regional Australia, nominated by a state or sponsored by an eligible relative.
routes.requirements: Points-tested, 65-point floor; under 45 at invitation; Competent English (IELTS 6 each). Must live, work and study only in a designated regional area. Pathway to PR via subclass 191 after 3 years living/working in regional Australia meeting an income condition — the exact 191 income amount is UNVERIFIED and not coded.

checker.points_system: Points test: 65-point floor incl. nomination/sponsorship points
checker.min_language: Competent English — IELTS 6.0 in each component or equivalent
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Subclass 191 PR step has an income condition — amount UNVERIFIED, do not hard-code
checker.min_education: Qualification assessed as comparable by the occupation's assessing authority
checker.occupation_list_required: Skilled occupation list (broader list than 189/190) plus state criteria
checker.notes: Provisional visa, not PR at grant. Regional-area residence is a visa condition.

routes.fees: From AUD 6,140 (main applicant)

family.spouse: Yes, included; family must also comply with regional conditions
family.parents: No — separate Parent visa only.

routes.pr_path: PR via subclass 191 after 3 years in regional Australia meeting the income condition. Citizenship thereafter under the usual 4-year rule.
routes.obstacles: Three extra years before PR versus 189/190; employment must genuinely be regional; 191 income evidence is scrutinised.
next_steps: Check the broader 491 occupation list and state criteria
Complete skills assessment and English test

Plan for 3 years of regional work before the 191 application

routes.name: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482)
routes.who_for: Skilled workers with a sponsoring Australian employer in an eligible occupation.
routes.requirements: Employer sponsorship and nomination required. English: IELTS 5.0 in each component or equivalent. At least 1 year of relevant work experience. Salary must meet the stream's income threshold: Core Skills Income Threshold AUD 79,423, Specialist Skills Income Threshold AUD 146,576 (both from 1 Jul 2026). Occupation must be on the Core Skills Occupation List (or meet the Specialist Skills salary test).

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Salary ≥ AUD 79,423 (Core Skills) or ≥ AUD 146,576 (Specialist Skills), from 1 Jul 2026
checker.occupation_list_required: Core Skills Occupation List, unless Specialist Skills stream salary test met

family.spouse_work: Partner generally has unrestricted work rights on the 482
family.parents: No — separate Parent visa only.

routes.pr_path: After 2 years working for the sponsor, employer can nominate for the subclass 186 Temporary Residence Transition stream (permanent residence). Citizenship under the usual 4-year rule after PR.
routes.obstacles: Wholly dependent on finding a sponsoring employer; changing employers requires a new nomination. The 2-year clock for PR runs with the sponsoring employer.

Confirm the role's salary clears AUD 79,423 (or 146,576 for Specialist)
Employer lodges sponsorship and nomination
Lodge the 482 application once nominated

routes.name: EU Blue Card
routes.who_for: Degree-holding professionals with a concrete German job offer at or above the salary threshold.
routes.requirements: Recognised/comparable degree (check anabin or get a ZAB assessment). Binding job offer (at least 6 months). Salary 2026: €50,700 gross/year standard; €45,934.20 for shortage occupations, recent graduates (degree within last 3 years) and IT specialists. IT specialists without a degree qualify with at least 3 years' relevant experience in the last 7 years. No German required for the card itself.

checker.min_language: None for the card; German A1 shortens settlement to 27 months, B1 to 21 months
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: €50,700/yr (2026); €45,934.20 shortage/new-entrant/IT
checker.min_education: Recognised degree (anabin/ZAB) — waived for IT specialists with 3 yrs experience in last 7
checker.occupation_list_required: Lower threshold applies to the official shortage-occupation list
checker.notes: Thresholds reset every January.

routes.fees: Visa fee €75; residence permit issuance up to €100; optional employer fast-track procedure €411

family.spouse: Yes — spouse can join; spouses of Blue Card holders can work without restriction
family.parents: Possible for skilled-worker residence titles first issued on/after 1 Mar 2024 (§36 residence Act) if subsistence and health insurance are self-funded — case-specific, verify before promising.

routes.pr_path: Settlement permit after 27 months with German A1, or 21 months with B1. Citizenship generally after 5 years.
routes.obstacles: Degree comparability is the common bottleneck — start the anabin/ZAB check before applying for jobs. Salary must clear the threshold for your exact category, not approximately.
next_steps: Check your degree on anabin; apply to ZAB if not listed
Secure an offer at/above the correct 2026 threshold
Employer can optionally run the €411 fast-track procedure
Apply for the Blue Card visa, then the residence permit on arrival

Applicants aged 45+ must earn at least €55,770 (2026) or prove adequate pension provision. Settlement after 3 years (2 years if trained in Germany).

checker.min_education: Recognised vocational qualification or degree
checker.occupation_list_required: Job must match the recognised qualification
checker.notes: Age 45+ salary rule is a hard checker branch.

routes.fees: Visa fee €75; residence permit up to €100; optional fast-track €411

family.parents: Possible for titles first issued on/after 1 Mar 2024 (§36) with self-funded subsistence/insurance — verify case by case.

Secure a matching job offer

Apply for the work visa

routes.name: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte)
routes.who_for: Job-seekers who want to come to Germany for up to a year to find qualified work — no job offer needed.
routes.requirements: Two doors. Door 1 (full recognition): qualification fully recognised in Germany — no points and no language proof needed. Door 2 (points): at least 6 points across qualification, experience, language, age, prior Germany stay and partner criteria; language German A1 or English B2; vocational training (≥2 years) or degree state-recognised at home. routes.name: Employment Pass (EP)

Most applicants must also pass COMPASS with at least 40 points across C1 salary, C2 qualifications, C3 diversity, C4 local employment, plus C5 Skills Bonus (shortage occupation list) and C6 Strategic Economic Priorities. countries.sources_note: u.ae / ICP (icp.gov.ae) / GDRFA, verified 2026-11-12. Cross-cutting: UAE has NO points system, NO permanent residence and NO ordinary citizenship path (citizenship is nomination-only for exceptional categories). General family-sponsorship rule: salary ≥ AED 4,000, or AED 3,000 + accommodation (spouse, unmarried daughters, sons under 25, children with special needs). Spouse working needs their own 2-year family-sponsorship work permit. Parents: only 1-year sponsorship with a guarantee deposit (amount unstated) — no verified salary threshold; do NOT use AED 20,000. Residence is generally nullified after >180 days outside the UAE (Golden/Green holders exempt). countries.sources_note: USCIS / travel.state.gov only, verified 2026-11-12, USD. The US has NO points system, no general age limit and no general English requirement for work/green-card routes (English + civics apply only at naturalisation, generally 5 years as a green-card holder). Parents are NEVER derivatives on employment routes; a green-card holder cannot petition for a parent — only a US citizen aged 21+ can, which in practice means parents can be sponsored only years later. FEE WARNING: I-129/I-140/I-485/I-907 amounts come from the USCIS Form G-1055 fee schedule (Oct 2026 edition) as reproduced in official-source summaries; the G-1055 PDF itself could not be opened in the research session (429). Re-open G-1055 and confirm every fee before the checker publishes fee figures. Visa Bulletin dates are for the November 2026 Bulletin and change monthly — re-verify on travel.state.gov before publishing. NO official wait-time exists for India EB queues — never convert Bulletin dates into estimated years.

routes.name: H-1B Specialty Occupations
routes.who_for: Professionals with a US employer offer for a graduate-level 'specialty occupation' job.
routes.requirements: US bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in a directly related specific specialty (or licence/experience equivalent), and the job must normally require that degree. Employer must pay at least the DOL prevailing wage for the role and area (LCA). No closed occupation list, no points, no English test, no age limit. Annual cap 65,000 plus 20,000 for US master's holders; cap-exempt employers (universities, nonprofits) skip the cap. From FY2027 selection is wage-weighted: registrations count 4× at OEWS wage Level IV, 3× at III, 2× at II, 1× at I. Stay up to 3 years, extendable to 6 (longer in defined green-card-pending cases).

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Must be paid ≥ DOL prevailing wage for the occupation/area (no fixed dollar figure)
checker.min_education: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a field directly related to the job
checker.occupation_list_required: No list — job must be a 'specialty occupation'
checker.notes: Cap-subject cases need electronic registration first (USD 215 per beneficiary, verified). From 21 Sep 2025 a USD 100,000 Proclamation payment is required for certain petitions for beneficiaries outside the US without a valid H-1B visa (verified on the USCIS H-1B page) — check the live USCIS page, as litigation/reporting changes the picture.

routes.fees: Registration USD 215 (verified). I-129 base from G-1055 (re-verify): USD 780 paper / 730 online; USD 460 small employers/nonprofits; Asylum Program Fee USD 600/300/0; ACWIA USD 1,500/750; Fraud Prevention USD 500; premium processing (I-907) USD 2,965. Plus the USD 100,000 Proclamation payment where it applies. State Dept visa fee UNVERIFIED.

family.spouse: Spouse and unmarried children under 21 in H-4 status
family.spouse_work: Generally NO — only certain H-4 spouses (once the H-1B worker's green-card process has started, e.g. approved immigrant petition) may get an EAD
family.parents: Never derivatives — no parent route from H-1B.

routes.pr_path: Temporary status only (6-year max with exceptions). Green card normally via employer EB-2/EB-3 (or EB-1) — subject to the India backlog. Citizenship generally 5 years after the green card.
routes.obstacles: Cap + wage-weighted selection means no offer at a strong wage level = weak odds; the USD 100,000 payment changes employer economics for overseas hires; the real long-term bottleneck is the India EB queue (see EB-2). After job loss there is a grace period of up to 60 days to find a new employer/change status/depart.
next_steps: Secure a genuine specialty-occupation offer
Compare the offered wage with the DOL prevailing wage (it drives weighted selection)
Employer files the LCA, then registers in cap season (USD 215)
If selected, employer files I-129 in the filing window; check whether the USD 100,000 payment applies to your case on the live USCIS page
Outside the US: visa interview at the US Embassy/Consulate

routes.name: L-1A / L-1B Intracompany Transferee

routes.requirements: Employed abroad continuously for 1 year within the last 3 years by the same group (parent/branch/subsidiary/affiliate) in a managerial, executive or specialised-knowledge role. Both entities must be doing business. NO degree requirement, no prevailing wage, no cap and no lottery. US employer files I-129 with L Supplement (or uses an approved blanket L). Max stay 7 years (L-1A) / 5 years (L-1B). NOTE: USCIS L-1 pages could not be opened in full in the research session (429); content verified via State Dept FAM and USCIS Policy Manual — re-open USCIS pages before publishing.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: No prevailing-wage requirement
checker.min_education: None required
checker.notes: min_experience_years = 1 continuous year abroad in the last 3, in a qualifying capacity, for the same group. needs_job_offer = the US role must be within the same group.

Document the corporate relationship and that both entities are doing business
US entity files I-129 + L Supplement (or blanket L)
If permanence is the goal, assess EB-1C early — L-1 time is capped

routes.name: O-1A Extraordinary Ability
routes.who_for: Professionals in sciences, education, business or athletics who are at the very top of their field.
routes.requirements: Either a major internationally recognised award, OR evidence of at least 3 of the 8 regulatory criteria (prizes, expert-judged memberships, published material about you, judging others' work, original contributions of major significance, scholarly authorship, leading/critical role for distinguished organisations, high salary relative to the field) — followed by a final-merits assessment of the totality. No degree requirement, no fixed experience years, no cap, no lottery. A US employer, US agent or foreign employer via a US agent must petition — no self-petition (a beneficiary-owned company may petition). Up to 3 years, then 1-year extensions. NOTE: the USCIS O-1 page returned access errors to automated readers; criteria are 8 CFR 214.2(o)(3)(iii) as reflected in USCIS guidance — re-open before publishing.

checker.min_education: None required
checker.notes: needs_job_offer = a petitioner (employer/agent) is required; the individual cannot self-petition. Meeting 3 of 8 criteria does not guarantee approval — final-merits review follows.

routes.fees: From G-1055 (re-verify): I-129 O classification USD 1,055 paper / 1,005 online; USD 530 small employer; Asylum Program Fee 600/300/0; premium processing USD 2,965. State visa fee UNVERIFIED.

family.spouse_work: NO — O-3 spouses have no work authorisation
family.parents: Never derivatives.

routes.pr_path: Temporary only. Common next step is EB-1A (similar evidence, self-petitionable) or EB-2 NIW. Citizenship generally 5 years after green card.

next_steps: Audit your record against all 8 criteria; find at least 3 with independent proof
Close gaps first (judging, scholarly/major-media coverage, documented uptake of your work)

File I-129 + O Supplement with the consultation opinion and evidence portfolio
In parallel, assess EB-1A / EB-2 NIW

routes.name: EB-1 First Preference (green card)
routes.who_for: EB-1A extraordinary ability; EB-1B outstanding professors/researchers; EB-1C multinational managers/executives.
routes.requirements: NO labour certification (PERM) for any EB-1 subcategory. EB-1A: sustained national/international acclaim — major international award OR at least 3 of 10 regulatory criteria; NO job offer and self-petition allowed. EB-1B: international recognition as outstanding in an academic field, 3+ years teaching/research, qualifying job offer required. EB-1C: 1 year abroad in the last 3 with a qualifying group entity in a managerial/executive role, plus a US managerial/executive offer from the same group. No age, English, salary or investment requirements.

family.spouse_work: Spouse in the US may seek work authorisation while adjustment is pending
family.parents: NOT derivatives — ever.

routes.pr_path: This IS a green card (after I-140 + I-485/consular step when the priority date is current). Citizenship generally 5 years as a green-card holder.

next_steps: Test EB-1A first — no employer and no PERM needed
L-1A executives: test EB-1C with the same group
File the I-140 — the filing date becomes your priority date
Monitor the monthly Visa Bulletin (India, EB-1) and the USCIS chart announcement
File I-485 or consular-process when your date is reached

routes.name: EB-2 Second Preference — standard (employer-sponsored)
routes.who_for: Advanced-degree professionals, or people of exceptional ability, with a permanent US job offer.
routes.requirements: Qualify via advanced degree (US master's+ or foreign equivalent, OR bachelor's + 5 years progressive post-degree experience, and the job must require it) OR exceptional ability (expertise significantly above ordinary, evidenced by at least 3 USCIS criteria). Employer normally first obtains an approved PERM labour certification (DOL ETA-9089, prevailing wage, recruitment test), then files I-140 and must show ability to pay. Job offer required — no self-petition on the standard route.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Employer must pay at least the DOL prevailing wage under PERM (no fixed dollar figure)
checker.min_education: Master's+ or bachelor's + 5 yrs progressive experience (advanced-degree limb), or exceptional ability
checker.notes: Priority date = PERM filing date. For India this category is a rationing queue (see obstacles) — the checker must surface the current Visa Bulletin dates, date-stamped.

routes.fees: From G-1055 (re-verify): I-140 USD 715/665 + Asylum Program Fee 600/300/0; PERM has no USCIS filing fee; then I-485 USD 1,440/1,390 (child 950/900) or consular fees (UNVERIFIED); premium processing USD 2,965.

family.spouse: Spouse and unmarried children under 21 are derivatives — green cards only when a visa is available for India (derivatives count against the same numbers)
family.spouse_work: Possible while adjustment is pending, once filing is permitted
family.children: Derivatives under 21, unmarried — ageing-out (CSPA) needs case-specific legal advice
family.parents: NOT derivatives — ever.

routes.pr_path: Green card category — but for India, grant is controlled by the Visa Bulletin. Citizenship 5 years AFTER the green card is actually granted, not after filing.
routes.obstacles: THE most important fact in the US dataset: November 2026 Visa Bulletin, India EB-2 Final Action 01NOV13, Dates for Filing 15JAN15 (rest of world EB-2 Final Action 01APR25). A new 2026 PERM/I-140 filer has a priority date years behind the cutoff — an approved petition does not mean a green card in the near term. Employer runs PERM recruitment and files ETA-9089 — earlier priority date is better
Employer files I-140 with the approved PERM and ability-to-pay evidence
Preserve lawful status while waiting (H-1B beyond-6-year extensions may apply)
Track the Visa Bulletin monthly; file I-485 only when the USCIS chart permits for your priority date

routes.name: EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW)
routes.who_for: Advanced-degree professionals and exceptional-ability people — researchers, STEM specialists, entrepreneurs — whose proposed US work is in the national interest.
routes.requirements: First independently qualify for EB-2 (advanced degree or exceptional ability). Then meet all three Matter of Dhanasar prongs: (1) the proposed endeavour has substantial merit AND national importance; (2) you are well positioned to advance it; (3) on balance it benefits the US to waive the job-offer and labour-certification requirements. Job offer and PERM are waived — self-petition on I-140 with a specific proposed endeavour. No age, English, salary or funds requirements.

checker.min_education: Must first meet EB-2 advanced-degree or exceptional-ability standard
checker.notes: NIW removes the employer and PERM — it does NOT shorten the India EB-2 queue. Same Bulletin dates as standard EB-2.

routes.fees: From G-1055 (re-verify): I-140 USD 715/665 + Asylum Program Fee USD 300 (self-petitioner); then I-485 USD 1,440/1,390 or consular fees (UNVERIFIED); premium processing USD 2,965.

family.spouse: Derivatives — green cards only when an India EB-2 visa is available
family.spouse_work: While adjustment is pending, once filing is permitted
family.parents: NOT derivatives — ever.

routes.pr_path: Green card category (EB-2). Priority date = I-140 filing date. Citizenship 5 years after the green card is granted.
routes.obstacles: Two hurdles: EB-2 standing AND all three Dhanasar prongs with forward-looking evidence — a strong CV alone is not enough. Decisive limit: India EB-2 Final Action 01NOV13 (Nov 2026) — an approved NIW gives you a petition and a priority date, not a green card and not by itself permission to live/work in the US.
next_steps: Confirm EB-2 standing (advanced degree or exceptional ability)
Define ONE specific endeavour; map evidence to each Dhanasar prong
Self-file I-140 requesting the NIW — filing date = priority date
Maintain separate lawful status/residence plans while the date is not current
File I-485/consular-process only when the Bulletin/USCIS chart permits

routes.name: EB-3 Third Preference
routes.who_for: Skilled workers, professionals (bachelor's), and other workers with a permanent US job offer.

Professional: job requires a US bachelor's (or foreign equivalent) and the applicant holds it. Other worker: job requires under 2 years. Employer obtains approved PERM (ETA-9089) and files I-140, proving ability to pay at least the prevailing wage from the priority date. Job offer required in every subcategory; no self-petition and no NIW equivalent.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Employer pays ≥ DOL prevailing wage under PERM (no fixed dollar figure)
checker.min_education: Bachelor's for the Professional subcategory; none fixed for Skilled/Other
checker.notes: min_experience_years = 2 applies to the Skilled Worker subcategory only. Checker must branch by subcategory and surface current India EB-3 Bulletin dates.

routes.fees: From G-1055 (re-verify): I-140 USD 715/665 + Asylum Program Fee 600/300/0; then I-485 USD 1,440/1,390 (child 950/900) or consular fees (UNVERIFIED); premium processing USD 2,965.

family.spouse: Derivatives — green cards when an India EB-3 visa is available
family.spouse_work: While adjustment is pending, once filing is permitted
family.parents: NOT derivatives — ever.

routes.pr_path: Green card category, subject to India availability. Citizenship 5 years after grant.

EB-3 'Other Workers' is a separate, even more limited sub-queue — do not conflate.
next_steps: Match the subcategory (skilled/professional/other) to the actual job requirements
Employer runs PERM and files ETA-9089 (sets the priority date)
Employer files I-140 with the approved PERM
Preserve US status while waiting
File I-485/consular-process when the chart reaches your priority date

routes.name: EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program (post-RIA 2022)
routes.who_for: Investors committing substantial lawful capital to a US new commercial enterprise that creates US jobs — no employer or degree needed.
routes.requirements: Investment for petitions filed on/after 15 Mar 2022: USD 1,050,000 standard, or USD 800,000 in a Targeted Employment Area (rural, or unemployment ≥150% of national average) or an infrastructure project. Amounts are inflation-adjusted every 5 years — the first adjustment applies to petitions filed on/after 1 Jan 2027, so these figures do not apply unchanged to 2027 filings. Must create full-time jobs (≥35 hrs/week) for at least 10 qualifying employees — direct jobs for standalone (I-526); direct/indirect for regional-center projects (I-526E). Regional Center Program authorised through 30 Sep 2027. Capital must be lawfully sourced, owned/controlled by the investor, and genuinely at risk — guaranteed-return structures do not qualify. Annual set-asides: 20% rural, 10% high-unemployment, 2% infrastructure. No education, experience, age or language requirements. Self-petition.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: USD 1,050,000 standard / USD 800,000 TEA or infrastructure (petitions from 15 Mar 2022; inflation adjustment from 1 Jan 2027 filings)
checker.min_education: None
checker.notes: 10 full-time US jobs is a hard outcome test enforced at the I-829 stage, not at filing.

routes.fees: Capital (not a fee): USD 800,000/1,050,000. I-526/I-526E filing fee USD 3,675 (pre-Apr-2024 amount to which USCIS states EB-5 fees reverted — verify in current G-1055). EB-5 Integrity Fund fee and I-829 fee: UNVERIFIED — excluded. Reports of a new EB-5 fee schedule from 30 Nov 2026 are NOT verified — do not publish post-Nov-2026 fees until G-1055 is re-checked. I-485 USD 1,440/1,390 or consular fees (UNVERIFIED).

family.parents: NOT derivatives. Only a naturalised citizen aged 21+ can later petition for a parent.

routes.pr_path: Direct green-card route but CONDITIONAL for 2 years: file I-829 proving the investment was sustained and 10 jobs created/maintained to remove conditions. Citizenship generally 5 years after residence begins. India EB-5 Unreserved Final Action was reported as 01DEC23 in Nov 2026 Bulletin summaries (re-verify); set-aside currency for India is UNVERIFIED — never publish 'current' claims without opening the current Bulletin.
routes.obstacles: Capital must be genuinely at risk — loss is possible with no green-card guarantee if the project fails or jobs are not created. Source-of-funds tracing (including India-earned or gifted funds) is document-heavy. Thresholds rise for filings from 1 Jan 2027; regional-center authorisation runs only to 30 Sep 2027.
next_steps: Choose standalone (I-526, direct jobs) vs regional center (I-526E, indirect jobs count)
Confirm TEA/infrastructure status (USD 800,000) vs standard (USD 1,050,000) using USCIS definitions, not marketing labels
Complete the lawful source/path-of-funds file BEFORE transferring capital
File I-526/I-526E — filing date = priority date
After 2 years of conditional residence, file I-829 to remove conditions

countries.sources_note: Immigration New Zealand (immigration.govt.nz) ONLY, verified 2026-11-12, NZD. Skilled-residence wage threshold (median wage) = NZD $35.00/hour from 9 Mar 2026 (June 2025 median; previously $33.56). Multiples: 1.1× = $38.50, 1.5× = $52.50, 2× = $70.00, 3× = $105.00. SMC changes effective 24 Aug 2026 are in force. General pattern: Resident Visa = live in NZ indefinitely; Permanent Resident Visa after 2 years as resident meeting conditions/commitment. INZ's general statement that citizenship may be possible after 5 years as a resident is INDICATIVE ONLY (detail sits with DIA — UNVERIFIED within the source rule). Parents can NEVER be included in a professional's application — only via the separate routes (Parent Resident Visa, Parent Boost Visitor Visa).

routes.name: Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa (SMC)
routes.who_for: Skilled professionals with a skilled job or job offer from an accredited NZ employer who can reach the points or experience thresholds.
routes.requirements: Age 55 or younger. A current job or offer from an ACCREDITED employer is mandatory: full-time (≥30 hrs/wk), permanent or fixed-term ≥12 months, paid at least $35.00/hr for ANZSCO skill level 1–3 jobs, or $52.50/hr (1.5×) for ANZSCO 4–5/unlisted. English: principal applicant IELTS overall 6.5 (or TOEFL iBT 79, PTE Academic 58, B2 First 176, OET C+), in-person, ≤2 years old. POINTS PATHWAY: 6 points required (realistic passing level = exactly 6). Claim 3–6 points from ONE source only — qualification, NZ occupational registration, or income — topped up only by NZ skilled work experience (1 pt = 1 yr, 2 pts = 1.5 yrs, 3 pts = 2 yrs, at the SMC wage threshold). Qualifications (from 24 Aug 2026): doctorate 6; NZ master's with bachelor's 6; overseas master's with bachelor's 5; NZ bachelor's 5; overseas bachelor's 4; overseas honours/PG diploma/cert with bachelor's 4. Income points: 3 pts at 1.5× ($52.50/hr), 4 pts at 2× ($70.00), 6 pts at 3× ($105.00). Overseas qualifications need an NZQA IQA unless on the exempt list. TWO NON-POINTS PATHWAYS in the same visa: Skilled Work Experience pathway (ANZSCO 1–3 job at ≥1.1× = $38.50/hr, 3 years' relevant experience anywhere PLUS 2 further years skilled work in NZ; Amber List jobs need 1.2×; Red List excluded) and Trades & Technician pathway (listed occupation, Level 4+ qualification, 2.5 years post-qualification experience plus 1.5 years in NZ, paid ≥ $35.00/hr). Process: free EOI → invitation → lodge within 4 months. No settlement-funds requirement.

checker.points_system: 6 points required: 3–6 from ONE of qualification/registration/income, plus NZ skilled-work top-ups only (1 pt/yr, 2 pts/1.5 yrs, 3 pts/2 yrs). Alternative non-points pathways exist (Skilled Work Experience; Trades & Technician)
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Job paid ≥ NZD $35.00/hr (ANZSCO 1–3) or ≥ $52.50/hr (ANZSCO 4–5/unlisted); income points at $52.50/$70.00/$105.00 per hour
checker.min_education: Points depend on level: overseas bachelor's = 4 pts; NZQA IQA needed unless exempt
checker.occupation_list_required: ANZSCO skill level governs the wage threshold; Red List occupations excluded from two pathways
checker.notes: Despite being the flagship 'points' visa, a NZ job offer from an accredited employer is MANDATORY — there is no offshore, no-offer points route in NZ.

routes.fees: EOI NZD $0; residence application from NZD $6,450 (fee $2,880 + levy $3,570; INZ table from 1 Oct 2024)

family.spouse: Partner and dependent children aged 24 or younger can be included in the same application
family.spouse_work: Partner included gets residence — open work rights as a resident
family.parents: NEVER includable — only the separate Parent Resident Visa or Parent Boost Visitor Visa, and only once the child is a resident/citizen.

routes.pr_path: This IS a Resident Visa. Permanent Resident Visa after 2 years as resident meeting conditions. Citizenship possibly after 5 years as resident (indicative; DIA criteria UNVERIFIED).
routes.obstacles: Most overseas-qualified applicants cannot reach 6 points without first working in NZ (typically on an AEWV) — the realistic sequence is job → AEWV → 1–2 years NZ work → SMC. Wage thresholds rise with the median wage; IQA assessment delays affect non-exempt Indian qualifications.
next_steps: Run the INZ SMC points calculator for your exact qualification/income
Start the NZQA IQA if your qualification is not on the exempt list
Target accredited employers with roles at ≥ $35.00/hr
Sit IELTS/PTE early, aiming for overall 6.5 (2-year validity)
Submit the free EOI only once you genuinely meet a pathway; lodge within 4 months of invitation

routes.name: Straight to Residence Visa (Green List Tier 1)
routes.who_for: Professionals whose job or offer is a Green List Tier 1 in-demand occupation meeting that occupation's exact requirements.
routes.requirements: Age 55 or younger. Job/offer with an ACCREDITED employer: full-time, permanent or fixed-term ≥12 months (or contract(s) ≥6 months). Occupation must be on Green List Tier 1 (Appendix 13) — verified examples include engineers, Registered Nurses in named specialities, auditors, Construction Project Manager, Quantity Surveyor, Surveyor, specified ICT roles, medical specialists. Pay at least the rate specified for the occupation, or $35.00/hr if none is specified — specified rates can be far higher (External Auditor ≥ $45.50/hr; Systems Administrator ≥ $70.00/hr). Qualification/registration exactly as specified per occupation; overseas qualifications may need IQA. English: IELTS overall 6.5 or equivalent. No points, no funds requirement.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Occupation-specified rate, else ≥ NZD $35.00/hr (examples: External Auditor ≥ $45.50/hr; Systems Administrator ≥ $70.00/hr)
checker.min_education: Exactly as specified for the Green List occupation; NZ registration where required
checker.occupation_list_required: Green List Tier 1 (Appendix 13) — exact occupation match required
checker.notes: Green List is volatile: announced changes from 8 Mar 2027 (e.g. Career Counsellor leaves Tier 1) — re-verify the list at application time.

routes.fees: From NZD $6,450 (fee $2,880 + levy $3,570)

family.spouse: Partner and dependent children ≤24 includable; family aged 16+ need IELTS 5.0 or paid ESOL lessons
family.spouse_work: Partner gets residence with open work rights
family.parents: NEVER includable — separate parent routes only.

routes.pr_path: Resident Visa on grant — NO prior NZ work period required. PRV after 2 years as resident.
routes.obstacles: The occupation must match the Tier 1 listing exactly, including qualification, registration and pay conditions — a similar job title is not enough. NZ professional registration (nursing/medical councils, Engineering NZ) can be the long pole.
next_steps: Search your exact occupation on the INZ Green List tool; note tier and all requirements
Start NZ registration or IQA if the occupation requires it
Apply only to accredited employers paying at/above the specified rate
Meet IELTS 6.5
Apply for residence directly once you hold the offer

routes.name: Work to Residence Visa (Green List Tier 2)
routes.who_for: Professionals in a Green List Tier 2 occupation who first work 24 months in NZ in that occupation.
routes.requirements: Age 55 or younger at the residence application. Core gate: 24 months working in NZ in a Tier 2 occupation within the 30 months immediately before applying, on a work visa (typically AEWV), paid at or above the required rate throughout the counting period, and a current job/offer with an accredited employer (full-time, permanent or ≥12-month fixed term). Wage: the occupation's specified rate, or $35.00/hr if none. From 24 Aug 2026 the applicable rate is locked to the rate in force when you started counting. Specified trades have their own rates (e.g. Metal Fabricator/Welder/Fitter/Machinist ≥ $43.63/hr; Panel Beater/Vehicle Painter/Paving Plant Operator ≥ $38.59/hr). English: IELTS overall 6.5. Related but separate visas with the same 24-in-30 pattern: Care Workforce WTR and Transport WTR.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Occupation-specified rate, else ≥ NZD $35.00/hr, for the whole 24-month counting period
checker.min_education: Per-occupation Green List requirements
checker.occupation_list_required: Green List Tier 2 — exact occupation match
checker.notes: min_experience_years = 2 means 24 months IN NZ in the occupation within a 30-month window. WARNING: 17 Tier 2 occupations leave this pathway from 8 Mar 2027 — check occupation status before starting the clock.

routes.fees: From NZD $6,450 (fee $2,880 + levy $3,570); preceding AEWV years are charged separately

family.spouse: Partner and dependent children ≤24 includable in the RESIDENCE application (16+: IELTS 5.0 or paid ESOL)
family.spouse_work: Partner gets residence with open work rights
family.children: Yes, ≤24, in the residence application — during the preceding AEWV years family need their own visas under AEWV rules
family.parents: NEVER includable — separate parent routes only.

routes.pr_path: Resident Visa after the 24 months. PRV after a further 2 years as resident.
routes.obstacles: No residence on day one — minimum ~2 years working in NZ first, and the 24 months must fall inside a 30-month window, so gaps or employer changes can break eligibility. Pay must stay at/above the required rate for the whole counting period.
next_steps: Confirm your occupation is Tier 2 (not Tier 1, not removed from Mar 2027) and record its specified wage
Enter on an AEWV with an accredited employer in the exact occupation
Keep payslips and contracts proving 24 months at/above the rate within 30 months
Meet IELTS 6.5 in time for the residence application
Apply as soon as the 24 qualifying months complete — and before turning 56

routes.name: Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV)
routes.who_for: Professionals with a full-time offer from an accredited NZ employer with an approved job check — the normal first step toward NZ residence.
routes.requirements: No maximum age in INZ's published criteria. Job offer: full-time (≥30 hrs/wk) from an ACCREDITED employer with an APPROVED JOB CHECK (three steps: employer accreditation → job check → worker visa). Tied to the employer/job/location; changing employer needs a Job Change. Wage: NO median-wage requirement since 10 Mar 2025 — must pay at least the NZ market rate for the role and at least minimum wage (exact current minimum-wage rate UNVERIFIED in this pass). Skills threshold — meet ONE: ≥2 years' relevant experience; OR a relevant Level 4+ qualification; OR a Green List job meeting its requirements; OR pay ≥ $70.00/hr (2× median). English required ONLY for ANZSCO skill level 3–5 jobs: IELTS overall 4.0 or PTE Academic 29. Stay: up to 5 years (skill levels 1–3) or 3 years (most skill level 4–5); after the maximum continuous stay, 12 months outside NZ before a new AEWV unless residence is reached first.

checker.min_language: IELTS overall 4.0 / PTE 29 ONLY for ANZSCO skill level 3–5 jobs; none for levels 1–2
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Market rate for the role; no median-wage requirement since 10 Mar 2025 (exact minimum-wage rate UNVERIFIED)
checker.min_education: One of: Level 4+ relevant qualification, 2 yrs experience, Green List compliance, or pay ≥ NZD $70.00/hr
checker.occupation_list_required: Employer must pass a job check for the specific role
checker.notes: min_experience_years applies only if using the experience limb of the skills threshold. AEWV time counts toward SMC/Green List residence only if occupation and wage meet residence thresholds from the start.

routes.fees: Worker application from NZD $1,540 (fee $480 + levy $1,060). Employer-side: standard accreditation NZD $775; job check NZD $735

family.spouse: Partner CANNOT be included in the AEWV — separate partner visa. Partner work-visa support generally requires an ANZSCO 1–3 role paid ≥80% of the median wage, or ≥1.5× median at any skill level, or a Green List role at ≥ the median (2025 Operational Manual FORMULA verified; the dollar figures tied to the old $33.56 median are superseded — use the formula, not hard dollars; post-Mar-2026 dollar update UNVERIFIED)
family.spouse_work: Possible via a separate partner work visa if the pay/skill formula is met
family.children: Separate visitor/student visas; supporting them requires earnings ≥ NZD $55,844/year gross (Operational Manual, Dec 2025; two AEWV parents may combine). ANZSCO 4–5 holders generally cannot support family visas except in specified cases
family.parents: No route via AEWV — parent routes open only once the child is a resident/citizen.

routes.pr_path: NO direct PR path — temporary only. It is a feeder: AEWV time in the right occupation at the right wage counts toward SMC points/pathways and the Green List Tier 2 24-month requirement.
routes.obstacles: Entirely employer-dependent. INZ warns job-offer scams targeting India/South Asia are common — genuine employers/recruiters cannot charge for a job. Skill level 4–5 roles get shorter stays and largely no family support.
next_steps: Verify the employer on INZ's accredited employer list before accepting any offer
Confirm the ANZSCO skill level and market rate — and the $35.00/hr residence threshold if residence is the goal
Evidence one skills-threshold route (2 years' experience or Level 4+/IQA)
Sit the English test only if your job is skill level 3–5
Apply online after the employer's job-check token is issued; never pay a recruiter for the job itself

routes.name: India Skilled Work Visa (NZ–India FTA)
routes.who_for: Citizens of India, outside NZ, with a full-time offer in a listed skilled occupation from an AEWV-accredited employer.
routes.requirements: In force 20 Oct 2026 under the NZ–India FTA. Indian passport holders only; must be OUTSIDE NZ for the first visa. Employer must be AEWV-accredited; NO job check required. Offer must be full-time (≥30 hrs/wk) in one of 11 listed occupations with per-sector caps on visas available (as at 20 Oct 2026: Software Engineer/Software & Applications Programmers/ICT Project Manager 1,000; Civil/Mechanical/Structural/Environmental Engineer 1,000; Construction Project Manager/Building Project Manager 700; Primary and Secondary School Teacher 500; Registered Nurse 900; Physiotherapist 300; FTA-wide ceiling of 5,000 Temporary Employment Entry holders in NZ at any time across skilled + iconic categories). Occupation-specific qualification/experience rules apply (e.g. ICT: a specified qualification route or ≥5 years' experience); NZ registration where required. An acceptable English test (≤2 years, in-person) is MANDATORY — per-occupation minimum scores are UNVERIFIED and not coded. Maximum total stay 3 years; then 3 years outside NZ before another India Skilled/Iconic visa. Fee UNVERIFIED — do NOT assume the AEWV fee.

checker.min_language: English test mandatory — per-occupation minimum scores UNVERIFIED, do not hard-code
checker.min_education: Occupation-specific (e.g. ICT qualification route or 5 yrs experience); NZ registration where required
checker.occupation_list_required: Closed list of 11 occupations with per-sector caps
checker.notes: Citizenship gate: Indian citizens only, applying from outside NZ. CRITICAL: time on this visa does NOT count toward any skilled-residence work-experience requirement.

routes.fees: UNVERIFIED — no official figure confirmed; do not reuse the AEWV NZD $1,540

family.spouse: UNVERIFIED — partner/child support rights not confirmed on official pages read; do not assume AEWV rules
family.parents: No route via this visa.

routes.pr_path: NO PR PATH — INZ states Temporary Employment Entry visas do not provide a pathway to residence, and this visa's work does not count toward skilled-residence experience requirements. Residence requires switching to a qualifying route (e.g. AEWV → SMC/Green List) on its own terms.
routes.obstacles: Hard sector caps, first-come; closed occupation list; the 3-years-in/3-years-out rule. The biggest trap: users may assume this 'skilled' visa builds residence time — it does not.
next_steps: Check your occupation and its sector cap on the INZ India Skilled Work Visa page
Read the per-occupation qualification/experience/registration requirements
Secure an offer (≥30 hrs/wk) from an AEWV-accredited employer
Sit the required English test
If residence is the real goal, compare the AEWV first — AEWV time can count toward residence, this visa's cannot

routes.name: Active Investor Plus Visa
routes.who_for: High-net-worth individuals investing at least NZD $5 million in acceptable NZ investments — a Resident Visa, not a work route.
routes.requirements: Choose ONE category: Growth — at least NZD $5 million for 36 months (managed funds on the Invest NZ acceptable list, Invest NZ-approved direct investments; philanthropy capped at 20%); or Balanced — at least NZD $10 million for 60 months (broader mix incl. listed equities, bonds, approved property/direct investments). Funds must be legally earned/acquired, transferred through the banking system, invested in NZD in NZ, and not for personal use. Time in NZ: Growth ≥21 days as resident over 36 months; Balanced ≥105 days over 60 months (reducible by 14 days per extra $1m in Growth-type investments, max reduction 42 days). NO age limit and NO English requirement (English removed 1 Apr 2025). No education/experience/points. Evidence checks at 24 months and at the end of the investment period.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Growth NZD $5,000,000 / 36 months; Balanced NZD $10,000,000 / 60 months
checker.min_education: None
checker.notes: Days-in-NZ test: Growth 21 days/36 months; Balanced 105 days/60 months (reducible).

routes.fees: NZD $27,470 total (application fee $12,070 + levy $15,400)

family.spouse: Partner and dependent children can be included; included family must enter NZ within 12 months of grant or reapply
family.children: Yes, included; a child born after grant joins via a Dependent Child Resident Visa
family.parents: NOT includable — parent routes apply separately once the investor is a resident.

routes.pr_path: Resident Visa from grant (travel conditions 4 years Growth / 6 years Balanced from first entry). Permanent Resident Visa after the investment period (36/60 months) once conditions are met and removed (removal: no cost).
routes.obstacles: Capital is genuinely at risk and locked for 3–5 years, with compliance checks at 24 months and period-end; failure to meet conditions can mean leaving NZ. Only Invest NZ-approved funds/direct investments qualify.
next_steps: Choose Growth ($5m/3 yrs) vs Balanced ($10m/5 yrs) by risk and time-in-NZ preference
Document the lawful source of funds and the banking transfer path
Use only Invest NZ-acceptable investments
Apply stating the category and nominated funds
Diarise the 24-month and end-of-period evidence requirements

routes.name: Business Investor Work Visa → Business Investor Resident Visa
routes.who_for: Experienced business people aged 55 or younger who will buy into and actively run an established NZ business.
routes.requirements: Invest at least NZD $1 million in an established business (residence after 3 years of running it) or at least NZD $2 million (fast-track residence after 12 months). Investment excludes GST, business property value and transaction fees, and must result in at least 25% ownership. Reserve funds of at least NZD $500,000 on top, to support yourself/family. The business must have traded ≥5 years, be lawful and operating in NZ, employ ≥5 FTE staff, not have been owned by you/family, and not have been used for an approved business-investor/entrepreneur application in the last 10 years; some business types are excluded (e.g. gambling, tobacco, fast food, franchises). Independent due diligence + Business Proposal form required (accountant's valuation/financial DD, NZ lawyer's legal DD). Experience: at least 3 years' acceptable business experience (self-employment in a business with ≥5 FTE staff or ≥$1m annual revenue; or senior management with ≥5 direct FTE reports and ≥$5m annual turnover). Age 55 or younger. English IELTS 5.0 or equivalent. Visa runs up to 4 years: Establishment stage ≤12 months (evidence of purchase/start within the first 9 months or the visa expires at 12 months), then Operating stage; one renewal of up to 2 years possible. Resident Visa conditions: actively run the business for the required period, maintain ≥5 FTE jobs, create and maintain ≥1 new FTE job for a NZ citizen/resident for ≥12 months, spend ≥184 days/year in NZ.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Investment ≥ NZD $1,000,000 (3-yr track) or ≥ NZD $2,000,000 (12-month fast track), PLUS ≥ NZD $500,000 reserve funds
checker.min_education: None — business-experience test instead
checker.notes: Must actively run the business — this is not a passive investment. Fast-track residents must still run the business for 3 years in total as a Resident Visa condition.

routes.fees: Work Visa NZD $12,380 (fee $11,320 + levy $1,060); Resident Visa NZD $14,890 (fee $11,320 + levy $3,570); total government fees both stages NZD $27,270 (before DD/legal/accounting costs)

family.spouse: Partner and dependent children can be included in the Work Visa application — partner may get a work visa, children student/visitor visas
family.spouse_work: Partner work visa available at the work-visa stage
family.children: Yes, included (student/visitor visas at work stage)
family.parents: NOT includable — separate parent routes only.

routes.pr_path: Resident Visa after 3 years ($1m) or 12 months ($2m) of compliant operation; PRV after 2 years as resident meeting conditions.
routes.obstacles: You must actually buy and run a real 5+-year-old, 5+-staff business; the purchase must complete inside the Establishment stage or the visa lapses. Job-creation and 184-days/year presence conditions are audited before residence.
next_steps: Confirm 3 years' acceptable business experience with documents
Identify a qualifying business; commission independent valuation and financial/legal due diligence
Prove the $1m/$2m funds (lawfully earned; limited borrowing) plus the $500k reserve
Meet IELTS 5.0 if needed; lodge with the Business Proposal form
Complete the purchase within 9 months of grant and run the business to the job/presence conditions from day one

routes.name: Parent Resident Visa (Parent Category) — separate route
routes.who_for: Parents (and grandparents/legal guardians in defined cases) of an adult NZ citizen or resident who can sponsor them — only AFTER the professional child is settled in NZ.
routes.requirements: Sponsor (the child): 18+, a NZ citizen or resident for at least 3 years, living in NZ, and present in NZ at least 184 days in EACH of the 3 years before the residence application. Can sponsor alone, or jointly with a partner or an adult sibling. Sponsor agrees to meet the parent's living costs for the first 10 years plus any deportation costs. Sponsor income test (taxable income on Inland Revenue statements, met in 2 of the 3 years before EOI selection; rates from 30 Apr 2026): single sponsor — 1.5× median wage for 1 parent = NZD $109,200/year, +0.5× median ($36,400) per additional parent (2 parents = $145,600); two joint sponsors — 2× median for 1 parent, +0.5× per additional parent. Process: EOI → selection → invitation (apply within 4 months). Annual cap 2,500 visas. Selection moved on 5 Oct 2026 to a hybrid model (~90% queue date order, ~10% ballot; first hybrid selection 10 Nov 2026); EOIs no longer expire if interest is re-confirmed every 2 years. Parent must meet health (medical + chest X-ray) and character (police certificates) standards; English — speak/understand English OR pre-purchase ESOL lessons. The parent's partner can be included if the relationship is genuine. No age, education, points or job-offer requirements.

checker.min_language: Parent: English OR pre-purchased ESOL lessons
checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: SPONSOR income: NZD $109,200/yr (1 sponsor, 1 parent), $145,600 (1 sponsor, 2 parents); joint sponsors 2× median for 1 parent — met in 2 of 3 tax years
checker.min_education: None
checker.notes: The test falls on the SPONSOR, not the parent. Sponsor must be a citizen/resident ≥3 years with ≥184 days/year in NZ.

routes.fees: EOI NZD $450; residence application NZD $5,360 (fee $1,940 + levy $3,420); total NZD $5,810

family.spouse: The parent's partner can be included in the same application
family.children: No provision verified to bring the parent's other dependent children as a family unit
family.parents: This route IS the parent route.

routes.pr_path: Resident Visa (indefinite stay) — BUT a Permanent Resident Visa only after holding the Parent Resident Visa for 10 years in a row, not the usual 2. Treat PRV timing as 10 years for this visa.
routes.obstacles: Cannot start until the child has been a resident/citizen for 3 years AND meets a high sponsor-income test sustained over 2 of 3 tax years. The 2,500/year cap with a queue means meeting the criteria does not mean quick selection. The sponsor is financially liable for 10 years, and the health standard can be decisive for older parents.
next_steps: Child secures residence first; track the 3-year and 184-days/year clocks
Child builds IRD-evidenced income of at least $109,200 (single sponsor, 1 parent) for 2 of 3 years
Lodge the parent's EOI ($450); keep details current and re-confirm interest every 2 years
On invitation, complete medicals and police certificates and lodge within 4 months
In parallel, assess the Parent Boost Visitor Visa for visits in the meantime

routes.name: Parent Boost Visitor Visa — separate, NOT residence
routes.who_for: Parents of NZ citizens/residents who want long stays while the Parent Resident Visa is unavailable or pending — visiting only.
routes.requirements: Apply from OUTSIDE NZ; sponsored by an adult child who is a NZ citizen/resident (sponsor present in NZ ≥184 days/year). Stay up to 5 years, multiple entry; a second 5-year visa is possible (10 years total maximum). Compliance check after 3 years (leave NZ, new medical certificate, prove insurance maintained). Money — meet ONE of: (a) sponsor income ≥ NZD $72,800/year for 1 parent (1× median; joint sponsors 1.5×; +0.5× per extra parent), evidenced over 2 of the last 3 tax years; (b) parent's own ongoing income ≥ $33,663.24/year single or $51,182.56/year couple; or (c) parent's own funds ≥ $170,000 single or $260,000 couple. Rates update each April. INSURANCE IS MANDATORY for the entire stay (12 months bought upfront after approval in principle): emergency medical cover ≥ $250,000/year, cancer treatment ≥ $100,000/year, plus repatriation and return of remains, from an insurer rated at least A (strong) or equivalent. Failing to maintain insurance can cancel the visa and damage future Parent Resident Visa eligibility. Full medical required. No age, education, language or points requirements.

checker.funds_or_salary_threshold: Sponsor income ≥ NZD $72,800/yr (1 parent) OR parent income ≥ $33,663.24/yr single / $51,182.56 couple OR parent funds ≥ $170,000 single / $260,000 couple; PLUS mandatory insurance (emergency ≥ $250,000/yr, cancer ≥ $100,000/yr)
checker.min_education: None
checker.notes: Visitor visa — NO work rights as a residence route, and INZ states expressly it is not a pathway to residence.

routes.fees: NZD $3,000 for most applicants (fee + levy) plus NZD $100 International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy; insurance premiums extra and significant

family.spouse: The applicant parent may include their partner (couple thresholds then apply)
family.children: No provision verified to include dependent children as a family unit
family.parents: This route IS for parents — as visitors only.

routes.pr_path: NONE — INZ expressly: this visa 'is not a pathway to residence'. Time on it does not advance the Parent Resident Visa (and breaking insurance conditions can harm that eligibility). Residence for parents = Parent Resident Visa only.
routes.obstacles: Insurance cost and availability for older parents, maintained continuously for 5–10 years, is the real price of this visa. Must apply offshore; the year-3 compliance check requires leaving NZ.
next_steps: Confirm the child sponsor meets the 184-days test and (if used) the $72,800 income test
Quote compliant insurance (≥$250k emergency / ≥$100k cancer) BEFORE applying
Choose the money route: sponsor income vs parent income vs parent funds
Apply from outside NZ; buy 12 months of insurance within 3 months of approval in principle
Diarise the year-3 offshore compliance check
